review.description: S1-S9 keep provider synchronization, request budgets, notification hints and posted review receipts. Question listing is local and does not poll GitHub.
review.implementation: GitHub providers, checkpoints, receipt refreshes and request gates are unchanged; the new queue calls only Store reads and emits no state transitions.
review.tests: The app assertion compares journal sequence before/after listing, while existing provider budget/pagination/receipt suites remain mapped. Local queue success is not evidence of fresh external inbox data.
